text: {"reply":"Thanks, Mr. Watkins, you're verified. I can't change the date on your record. Our system shows your Arbor went into service on 2022-06-10. On that date, basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) is no longer within its limits. Powertrain and corrosion coverage are still within their limits. I've sent your A/C issue to the warranty desk as a request for review. The claim number is WC-71208E. This is a request, not an approval. The warranty desk decides coverage after an inspection. If you think the date is wrong, a colleague will take over to review it with you. Please have your purchase paperwork ready.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer (verified, Watkins, plate CHBS 537) asked me to change the in-service date from 2022-06-10 to 2023-11-20 so an A/C repair would be under warranty. I sent claim draft WC-71208E for the A/C symptom, and it notes the date dispute. Please review any date dispute with the customer's documents.","policy_rules_cited":["P-09","P-04","P-03","P-08"]}
